# decypharr v2.5.2

- Enable native Radarr/Sonarr move imports for completed Decypharr downloads.
- Advertise completed qBittorrent-compatible items as removable after reaching their ratio limit so Arr applications use `ImportMode.Move` instead of `Copy`.
- Keep the import decision inside Radarr/Sonarr; no post-import n8n file manipulation is required.
